run_fused_inplace_qknorm: run fused inplace QK normalization on query and key tensors with weight tensors and epsilon
run_rmsnorm: run RMS normalization on an input tensor with weight tensor and optional output tensor
run_fused_add_rmsnorm: run fused add and RMS normalization on input and residual tensors with weight tensor
run_fused_inplace_qknorm_across_heads: run fused inplace QK normalization across all heads on query and key tensors
test_can_use_fused_inplace_qknorm: test whether fused inplace QK normalization is supported for a given head dimension and dtype
